question_variants: which channel brings the best customers
sql:
SELECT u.traffic_source,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS buyers,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 2) AS revenue_per_buyer
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` AS u ON u.id = oi.user_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY u.traffic_source ORDER BY revenue_per_buyer DESC
report: Channels are judged on revenue per acquired buyer, not total revenue. A channel delivering many low-value buyers can top the raw revenue table while being the worse channel.
